Subject: ArcheTech MAP kickoff — provisioning roadmap & lead times

Hi Emily —

Great to meet yesterday. Per our conversation, I attached a draft MAP that ties evaluation milestones to the procurement and provisioning timelines for a Private deployment (VPC). The primary asks below:

- Confirm target go-live month and any hard blackout windows for procurement or on-prem installs.
- Redline the attached MAP with preferred tranche sizes (we suggested 4 GPU nodes / 8 A100-equivalents per tranche).
- Share SOC 2 evidence owner so we can stage evidence for your compliance review.

Notes on lead times we pulled from infra:
- Reserved GPU capacity (dedicated pool): 8–10 weeks lead time for tranche allocation once contract signed.
- Private on-prem install + validation: 6–9 weeks (dependent on local rack/cabling and customer IT signoff).
- Canaries and acceptance window: recommend 2-week canary plus a 1-week remediation window before full traffic cutover.

I've attached archetech_map_v1.xlsx and a short SOC2 summary for context. If you can reply with target acceptance criteria and preferred tranche sizing by EOD Wed (18th), we will lock procurement milestones in the MAP and generate DocuSign.

Thanks —
Tessa
Senior Solutions Lead | Redwood Inference

Tessa / team — my estimates below (ops + procurement):

1) Redwood Dedicated:
- Contract signed -> pool reservation: 1–3 business days to allocate in our reservation system (conditional on tranche availability).
- Allocation -> customer-ready endpoints (networking, routing, IAM): ~10–14 business days.
- Total (best case): ~2–3 weeks.

Notes: Dedicated is the faster path to runbook-ready capacity. We can reserve a staging tranche (6 GPUs) immediately after contract signature and deliver a canary endpoint within ~10 days, assuming no complex VPC peering delays.

2) Redwood Private (customer-managed VPC / on-prem):
- Ordering any customer hardware / local infra is on customer timeline — our standard on-prem package assumes customer racks and cross-connects are ready.
- Private deployment lead time (our delivery + customer validation): 6–9 weeks in normal cases.

Sizing recommendations for their phased plan:
- Tranche A (staging): 6 GPUs (for canary) — validate runbook and latency SLOs
- Tranche B (initial prod): 18 GPUs — expected to handle baseline traffic and burst buffer
- Tranche C (scale): 24 GPUs — runway for 2–3x growth + headroom for batch jobs

Acceptance criteria suggestions (what our SRE will validate during canary):
- 95th percentile latency within agreed SLO under baseline load
- Throughput tests at 1.5x expected QPS without degradation
- Successful key rotation and audit logging enabled

I'll update the MAP spreadsheet with these timelines and add a DocuSign milestone for contract signature by Mar 5.

Ben
Director, Solutions Engineering | Redwood Inference

Attachments: none
